preorder.intro: Our meat is smoked in limited batches each day. Group orders lock in your cuts at booking. They're smoked and held for you, never sold to walk-ins.

policies.title: Service charge
policies.body: A service charge applies to groups. It is shown on your quote, not only in fine print. We confirm the rate and whether it is a gratuity when we send the quote.

policies.title: Headcount
policies.body: You're billed for the confirmed guest count. We set the deadline for final numbers on your quote.

policies.title: Cancellation
policies.body: Deposit and cancellation windows are confirmed on your quote, before you pay.

policies.title: Dietary
policies.body: The kitchen is pork-free and alcohol-free. Every meat we serve is halal. Tell us about allergies when you book.

faqs.a: Every meat we serve is halal, and the restaurant is pork-free and alcohol-free. Package menus list the cuts and sides; they do not carry a separate certification line until the certifying body is named on this site.

faqs.q: How far ahead do I need to book?
faqs.a: Lead times are listed with each event type on this page. Team lunches can be as little as 48 hours; holiday parties, iftars and buyouts need more notice.

faqs.q: What if you sell out of brisket?
faqs.a: Group orders lock in your cuts at booking. They're smoked and held for your group, never sold to walk-ins.

faqs.q: How much meat do I need per person?
faqs.a: Plan on about ¾ lb of cooked meat per guest for a mixed board, or ½ lb for a Team Lunch. The planning table on this page shows worked examples. Bone-in cuts weigh more; we'll confirm amounts on your quote.
Yes — pickup at the South Lake Union restaurant, or delivery. The delivery area and fee are confirmed on your catering quote. Everyday orders can also use Toast Delivery.
